# TextGraph issues and feedback

**[Report all TextGraph issues at drawmotive/textgraph/issues →](https://github.com/drawmotive/textgraph/issues)**

This is the shared tracker for bugs, feature requests, and questions about TextGraph, including the npm SDK, textgraph.dev documentation, playground, fonts, samples, Markdown, VitePress, and VS Code integrations.

Search existing issues first. For a bug, include the affected package or page, version, environment, expected and actual behavior, and a small TextGraph example when relevant. Screenshots help explain rendering or layout problems.
